crops.evidence: I worked out where the Name is from the image itself, not from the earlier locator. Reading right to left, the line has the end of יתלונן (cut off at the right edge), then a sof-pasuq colon, then אֹמַר, then the Name at the far left, starting with lamed at about x≈330. In that word (ל-י-ה-ו-ה), the vav is clearly thicker at the head than a plain vav, and a dot-like blob sits at the top of it next to the first he. That matches a holam merged with the vav head. A patah-like mark sits under the lamed and a qamats-like mark under the vav, which fits the usual vocalisation of the Name. This crop is lower resolution and more blurred than the other three, so I'm less confident here.

The Name is at the far left, after כִּי־גָדוֹל. Under the yod there is a shewa, and under the vav a qamats (the T-shaped mark at the bottom left). A small separate dot sits at the head of the vav, toward the first he, at the height of the letter tops. It is distinct from the vav stroke and looks like the same holam style seen in גָדוֹל in the same line.

This is the Name in כִּי־יָדִין יְהוָה עַמּוֹ, with a shewa under the yod and a qamats under the vav. There is a clear dot at the top of the vav, on the side next to the first he, at the same height and with the same look as the holam in עַמּוֹ in the same line. It is sharp and separate from the letter.

This is the Name in אֶת־יְהוָה: בֵּית הַלֵּוִי, with a shewa under the yod and a qamats under the vav. A dot sits at the top of the vav, at the gap between it and the first he. It is clearly visible, touches or nearly touches the vav head, and is at letter-top height like other holam dots on this page.

uncertainties: correct-s68-last.jpg: the image is blurry and the dot has merged into the vav head, so I can't fully rule out that what I'm calling a holam is just a thick or serifed vav head. I'd call my confidence moderate, not high.

In all four crops the dot sits between the first he and the vav head. At this resolution I can't tell whether it was printed as the he's holam or attached to the vav. Either way, I'm reporting that a holam mark is printed there.
I read only the images. I did not check them against a normalised text.
